messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great progress! Now that your SIM card is active, let's enable mobile data. Please use the following action on your phone:

**toggle_data**

This will turn your mobile data ON. After you've done that, please confirm and then we'll check your network status again to see if you now have a data connection.

I have turned mobile data on, and my phone now shows an excellent 5G signal with data enabled. The network status confirms that the SIM card is active, cellular connection is connected, and data roaming is enabled. What should I do next?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
